title: Walsh basis coordinates and Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The coordinate of $f$ at $T$ in the Walsh basis is its Fourier coefficient $\widehat f(T)=\mathbb E_x[f(x)(-1)^{\sum_{i\in T}x_i}]$, where the expectation is uniform over $\mathbb F_2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
$T$ is a subset of the coordinate indices
